column4: Full-bleed cinematic key art for a video game title screen, a stylised AAA 3D render (real-time in-engine look, physically based glossy materials, volumetric light, like a premium animated film still), 16:9, the image fills the whole frame edge to edge with no borders, no bands, no letterbox. NO text, NO letters, NO logo, no UI, no names or lettering on the hulls (plain glossy hulls). Chunky toy-like nautical world in glossy painted enamel and varnished timber. Two glossy toy sailing yachts, one signal red and one sunflower yellow, charge at each other head-on across a huge curling emerald-teal storm wave; on each foredeck ONE chunky toy captain with a big hat (the red boat: captain in red oilskin and yellow sou'wester; the yellow boat: duelist in navy tailcoat and tricorn) lunging with a striped jousting lance, the lance tips meeting in the centre in a burst of cream spray and wood splinters. A giant bright cyan lightning bolt strikes down behind the clash from bruised violet storm clouds, a low gold sun breaking under the clouds, cream foam and spray everywhere, heroic dynamic centred composition, darker calmer storm sky in the top quarter.
